{{Quote|Remember how the Mandos blockaded the Hydian Way during the war? How Coruscant was on the brink of starvation and riots, until some hero came along, broke the blockade, and saved the planet? Well, that hero was me.|[[Hylo Visz]]|<ref name="KotFE 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref>}}
In [[3661 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], '''riots''' broke out on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The contention was the result of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], which prevented resources from traveling along the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]. As starvation spread across the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] of Coruscant's [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], panicked citizens began protesting and rioting against the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senates]] inability to break the blockade. The riots ended in [[3660 BBY]], when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]] successfully led a [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|group]] of fellow vagabonds against the [[Mandalorian cruiser]]s.
